parameters.query: SELECT j.id,j.version,j.status,j.payload,COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',r.role,'actor',r.actor,'status',r.status)) FILTER(WHERE r.id IS NOT NULL),'[]'::jsonb) approvals FROM localization_jobs j LEFT JOIN localization_reviews r ON r.job_id=j.id AND r.job_version=j.version WHERE j.id=$1 GROUP BY j.id

nodes.name: Load Approved Job and Review Evidence

parameters.jsCode: if ($json.status !== 'approved') throw new Error('approved package required'); return [{json:{package:{...$json.payload,status:'approved'},approvals:$json.approvals}}];

parameters.query: INSERT INTO localization_exports(job_id,job_version,manifest,fingerprint) VALUES($1,$2,$3::jsonb,$4) ON CONFLICT(job_id,job_version) DO NOTHING; UPDATE localization_jobs SET status='export_ready',updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1 AND version=$2 AND status='approved' RETURNING id
